description: This file defines a struct for a fixed-size buffer and declares functions for populating this buffer with formatted time strings, specifically local time and UTC date/time in various formats.

classes.name: tr2_tbuf
classes.description: A simple wrapper struct around a fixed character buffer to facilitate easier handling of time-related string formatting without passing additional size parameters.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_local_time
methods.description: Populates the buffer with the current local time formatted as a string.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime_extended
methods.description: Fills the buffer with the current UTC date and time in an extended format.

methods.name: tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime
methods.description: Fills the buffer with the current UTC date and time in a standard format.
